name: top30-agents
description: Loops and graphs for agent work you don't have to watch, plus Claude Code's built-in commands used well. agent-graph-designer and agent-loop; goal-writer lints /goal conditions and ships goal gate, a Stop hook that keeps Claude working until a real command exits 0 (off until you switch it on); which-command picks the right built-in command; the batch-scout agent prepares safe /batch runs; harness-starter sets up a locked feature list, progress log and init script for multi-session work, with a separate harness-evaluator agent.
